# API error codes

<!-- Generated by `python manage.py error_codes`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every failed response has `success: false`, an `error_code` from this list, a
human-readable `message` (safe to show to users) and sometimes `errors` with
details. Branch on `error_code`, never on `message` text.

| Status | error_code | Default message | What the frontend should do |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `ASSIGNMENT_REVOKED` | This assignment has been revoked. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `BAD_REQUEST` | The request could not be processed. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `CONTACT_NOT_SET` | There is no email/phone of this type on the account. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `CONTACT_UNCHANGED` | This is already the email/phone on your account. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `EMAIL_LOGIN_NEEDS_PASSWORD` | Log in with your email and password. | Bug in the frontend: email logins use auth/login/. |
| 400 | `EMAIL_REQUIRED` | You can't remove the email: SMS isn't enabled yet, so it's the only way this account can sign in. | Show `message`: an email is needed while SMS is off. |
| 400 | `FEE_REQUIRED` | Enter the agreed fee (no fee structure exists for this standard and year). | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `FILE_TOO_LARGE` | The file is too large. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `FUTURE_DATE` | The date can't be in the future. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `GOOGLE_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` | This Google account's email address is not verified with Google. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `GOOGLE_NOT_LINKED` | No Google account is linked to this account. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `INACTIVE_REFERENCE` | One of the selected items is deactivated. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `INVALID_AMOUNT` | The amount must be more than zero. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | Email or password is incorrect. First time here or forgot your password? Use "Set or reset password". | Show `message` under the form; offer "Set or reset password". |
| 400 | `INVALID_PDF` | The file must be a valid PDF. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `INVALID_PHOTO` | The photo must be a JPEG, PNG or WebP image. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN` | The refresh token is invalid. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `INVITE_ALREADY_ACCEPTED` | This person has already logged in; no invite is needed. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `ITEM_ARCHIVED` | This item is archived and can't be assigned. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `LAST_CONTACT_METHOD` | You can't remove this: an account needs at least one email or phone to log in. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `LOGIN_TICKET_INVALID` | This sign-in has expired. Please enter your email and password again. | Go back to the email + password step. |
| 400 | `MARKS_OUT_OF_RANGE` | Marks must be between 0 and the paper's maximum marks. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `NOTE_REQUIRED` | A reason / note is required. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `NOTHING_CHANGED` | Nothing to change: the student already has these details. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `NOT_A_PAYMENT` | Only payments can be reversed. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `NOT_A_PORTAL_LOGIN` | Only parent/student (PORTAL) logins can be linked to students. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `NOT_ELIGIBLE` | Not an active student of this board. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `NO_CURRENT_ACADEMIC_YEAR` | Set a current academic year first (Academics → academic years). | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `NO_NEXT_STANDARD` | There is no next standard to promote to; use COMPLETE. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `OTP_EXPIRED` | This OTP has expired. Please request a new one. | Ask the user to request a new code. |
| 400 | `OTP_INVALID` | The OTP is incorrect or has expired. | Show `message` under the code box; let them retry. |
| 400 | `PARSE_ERROR` | Malformed request. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `PHOTO_TOO_LARGE` | The photo is too large. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `REFUND_TOO_LARGE` | The refund is more than what was paid. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `SUBJECT_FEE_NOT_CHARGED` | This subject's fee isn't on the account, so it can't be taken off. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Validation failed. | Show each entry of `errors` (field -> messages) next to its form field. |
| 400 | `WRONG_BOARD_YEAR` | That academic year belongs to a different board. | Show `message`. |
| 400 | `WRONG_PASSWORD` | Your current password is incorrect. | Show `message` under the current-password field. |
| 401 | `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` | Incorrect authentication credentials. | Call `token/refresh/` once and retry; if that fails, go to the login page. |
| 401 | `GOOGLE_TOKEN_INVALID` | The Google sign-in could not be verified. Please try again. | Call `token/refresh/` once and retry; if that fails, go to the login page. |
| 401 | `NOT_AUTHENTICATED` | Authentication credentials were not provided. | Call `token/refresh/` once and retry; if that fails, go to the login page. |
| 401 | `NO_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT` | The account no longer exists or was deactivated. | Go to the login page; show `message`. |
| 401 | `SESSION_EXPIRED` | This login has ended (logged out, or too old). Log in again. | Go to the login page; say the session ended. |
| 401 | `TOKEN_NOT_VALID` | Token is invalid or expired | Call `token/refresh/` once and retry; if that fails, go to the login page. |
| 403 | `ACCOUNT_DISABLED` | This account has been disabled. Please contact the institute. | Log out and show `message` on the login page. |
| 403 | `ANSWER_KEY_LOCKED` | The answer key becomes available after the test is over. | Show when it unlocks (test start + duration). |
| 403 | `CANNOT_MODIFY_SELF` | You cannot change your own role or account status. | Show `message` (not allowed). Don't retry. |
| 403 | `CSRF_HEADER_MISSING` | Missing the X-Requested-With header required when using the login cookie. | Bug in the frontend: send `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest` on refresh. |
| 403 | `OWNER_PROTECTED` | Owner accounts can't be changed by anyone else in the app. | Show `message` (not allowed). Don't retry. |
| 403 | `OWNER_REQUIRED` | Only the institute owner account can modify another administrator. | Show `message` (not allowed). Don't retry. |
| 403 | `PERMISSION_DENIED` | You do not have permission to perform this action. | Show `message` (not allowed). Don't retry. |
| 404 | `ANSWER_KEY_UNAVAILABLE` | No answer key is available. | Show a 'not found' state. |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | Not found. | Show a 'not found' state. |
| 405 | `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` | Method "{method}" not allowed. | Bug in the frontend: wrong HTTP method. |
| 406 | `NOT_ACCEPTABLE` | Could not satisfy the request Accept header. | Bug in the frontend: send `Accept: application/json`. |
| 409 | `ACCESS_ALREADY_GRANTED` | This login can already see this student. | Show `message`; the data changed or already exists. |
| 409 | `ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS` | An account with these details already exists. Please log in instead. | Show `message`; the data changed or already exists. |
| 409 | `ALREADY_REVERSED` | This payment has already been reversed. | Show `message`; the data changed or already exists. |
| 409 | `ALREADY_ROLLED_OVER` | This student already has an account for that academic year. | Show `message`; the data changed or already exists. |
| 409 | `CONFLICT` | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource. | Show `message`; the data changed or already exists. |
| 409 | `CONTACT_IN_USE` | This email/phone is already used by another account. | Show `message`; the data changed or already exists. |
| 409 | `DUPLICATE_DOCUMENT` | This exact PDF is already uploaded. Send confirm_duplicate: true to upload anyway. | Ask to confirm; resend with `confirm_duplicate: true`. |
| 409 | `GOOGLE_ACCOUNT_CONFLICT` | This account is already linked to a different Google account. Unlink it first, or sign in with the linked Google account. | Show `message`; the data changed or already exists. |
| 409 | `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` | This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different request. | Bug in the frontend: generate a new Idempotency-Key per new payment. |
| 409 | `LAST_ADMIN` | This is the last active administrator and cannot be demoted or deactivated. | Show `message`; the data changed or already exists. |
| 409 | `POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE_STUDENT` | A similar student already exists. Check the list in `errors`; send confirm_duplicate: true to admit anyway. | Show the candidates in `errors`; resend with `confirm_duplicate: true` if the admin confirms. |
| 409 | `SUBJECT_FEE_ALREADY_CHARGED` | This subject's fee is already on the account. | Show `message`; the data changed or already exists. |
| 415 | `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | Unsupported media type "{media_type}" in request. | Bug in the frontend: send JSON or multipart form data. |
| 429 | `LOGIN_LOCKED` | Too many wrong passwords. Please wait a few minutes and try again. | Show `message` with a countdown from `errors.retry_after_seconds`. |
| 429 | `OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED` | Too many incorrect attempts. Please request a new OTP. | Ask the user to request a new code. |
| 429 | `OTP_COOLDOWN` | Please wait before requesting another OTP. | Show a countdown from `errors.retry_after_seconds`, then enable 'Resend'. |
| 429 | `OTP_REQUEST_LIMIT_REACHED` | Too many OTP requests. Please try again later. | Show `message`; wait `errors.retry_after_seconds` before retrying. |
| 429 | `THROTTLED` | Request was throttled. | Show `message`; wait `errors.retry_after_seconds` before retrying. |
| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later. | Show a generic error with the `X-Request-ID` so it can be traced. |
| 503 | `DRIVE_API_DISABLED` | The Google Drive API is not enabled for this Google Cloud project. Enable it at APIs & Services -> Library -> Google Drive API, wait a minute, then retry. | Show `message`; the owner must fix the Drive setup. |
| 503 | `FILE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE` | File storage is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly. | Show `message`; let the user retry shortly. |
| 503 | `GOOGLE_NOT_CONFIGURED` | Google sign-in is not available right now. | Hide the Google button; use email OTP. |
| 503 | `GOOGLE_UNAVAILABLE` | Google sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again or use an OTP. | Offer email OTP login instead. |
| 503 | `OTP_DELIVERY_FAILED` | We couldn't send the OTP right now. Please try again shortly. | Show `message`; let the user retry shortly. |
| 503 | `OTP_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE` | OTP verification is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly. | Show `message`; let the user retry shortly. |
| 503 | `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later. | Show `message`; let the user retry shortly. |
| 503 | `THROTTLE_UNAVAILABLE` | Rate limiting is temporarily unavailable, so this request cannot be processed. Please try again shortly. | Show `message`; let the user retry shortly. |
